content: Deliverability best practice: hard bounces suppressed immediately and permanently; soft bounces suppressed after 3-4 consecutive failures treated as hard; sunset/win-back policy triggers on 60-90 days (aggressive) up to 6-12 months of zero opens/clicks, with 1-2 re-engagement emails before final suppression; spam complaint rate must stay under 0.1%; healthy bounce rate under 2%, above 5% signals a deliverability problem.
